items.title: How many candidate solutions does asking "why" unlock — and when does it go too far?
items.description: Starting from Mara's literal request ("a CSV export button"), each additional "why" reframes the problem statement further from a specific solution. Drag "How many whys deep" from 0 (the literal ask) up to 7 and watch two things move: how many realistic candidate solutions the resulting problem statement can be evaluated against, and how useful that statement actually is for choosing a build. Notice usefulness doesn't just keep climbing — L2's claim is that it peaks around 3-4 whys, then falls again once the statement over-abstracts into something no longer actionable.
items.compute: const depth = params.whysDepth; const solutionOptions = Math.round(1 + 3 * (1 - Math.exp(-depth / 2))); let usefulness; if (depth <= 4) { usefulness = 40 + depth * 15; } else { usefulness = 100 - (depth - 4) * 25; } usefulness = Math.max(5, Math.min(100, Math.round(usefulness))); return { solutionOptions, usefulness };
